profit.title: Real profit
profit.subtitle: Track what you put in, what you withdrew, each store's balance and your real profit.
profit.estimatedNote: Values with ≈ are estimated using the {fx} rate.
profit.estimatedNoFx: Values with ≈ are estimated using the dollar rate, which is not configured yet.
profit.emptyHint: Record deposits and balances to see the real profit.

summary.title: Summary
summary.realProfitHint: Net withdrawals + store balances (calculated available and pending) + stock − deposits, all in US dollars (US$).
summary.unavailableHint: The dollar rate is missing to calculate this value.
summary.pendingUnavailable: includes pending balance: unavailable (dollar rate missing)

legacyDeposits.one: {count} old deposit in BRL converted at the exchange rate (≈). Edit it to enter the store and credited amount.
legacyDeposits.other: {count} old deposits in BRL converted at the exchange rate (≈). Edit them to enter the store and credited amount.

withdrawalsWithoutFee.one: {count} withdrawal without a fee counts as fee 0.
withdrawalsWithoutFee.other: {count} withdrawals without a fee count as fee 0.

deposits.title: Deposits
deposits.intro: Money you put into the stores, in the store currency (for now, only US dollar stores). The amount paid in R$ is for reference only.
deposits.emptyHint: Record every time you put money into the stores. It counts toward the real profit.
deposits.gone: The deposit no longer exists. The list was refreshed.
deposits.deleteMessage: Delete the deposit of {value} made on {date}? This action cannot be undone.

form.amountRequired: Enter the amount credited to the store.
form.invalidMoney: Invalid amount. Use the format 1.25, greater than zero.

deposits.noUsdStores: No active US dollar store. Add one under Stores.
deposits.legacyStoreNotUsd: This old record's store is not in US dollars. Choose a US$ store.
deposits.amountBrlOptional: Amount paid in BRL (optional, for reference only)
deposits.legacyEditHint: This deposit was recorded in BRL only. Enter the store and the credited amount.

withdrawals.title: Withdrawals
withdrawals.intro: What you withdrew from the stores to your account, in the store currency. The net amount (withdrawn minus the fee paid) is what counts toward the real profit; the amount received in R$ is for reference only.
withdrawals.emptyHint: Record each withdrawal from a store to your account. It counts toward the real profit.
withdrawals.gone: The withdrawal no longer exists. The list was refreshed.
withdrawals.noWithdrawalStores: No active store allows withdrawals. Turn on "Allows withdrawal" on a store to record withdrawals.
withdrawals.deleteMessage: Delete the withdrawal of {value} made on {date}? This cannot be undone.

form.legacyHint: This withdrawal predates the required store. Choose the store and the amount withdrawn to be able to save it.
form.feeHint: Leave empty if you do not know ("not informed"); 0 = no fee paid.
form.feeSuggested: Suggested from the store's withdrawal fee. You can edit it.
form.feeNotConfigured: The store has no withdrawal fee configured; enter the fee paid, if you know it.
form.invalidMoney: Invalid amount. Use the format 1.25, greater than zero.
form.invalidFee: Invalid fee. Use the format 1.25 (0 is allowed) or leave it empty.

withdrawals.amountBrlOptional: Amount received in BRL (optional, for reference only)

storeBalances.title: Store balances
storeBalances.intro: Each store balance is calculated: deposits + released sales − purchases − withdrawals + adjustments. Check it against the website balance whenever you like. Sales with a hold show as pending until they are released.
storeBalances.nonWithdrawableTitle: This store does not allow withdrawals: the balance stays in it.

breakdown.title: How the available balance is calculated

legacyDepositsIgnored.one: {count} old deposit (no amount credited to the store) is left out of the calculation. Edit it to enter the credited amount.
legacyDepositsIgnored.other: {count} old deposits (no amount credited to the store) are left out of the calculation. Edit them to enter the credited amount.

currencyMismatchIgnored.one: {count} item in a currency different from the store was ignored in the calculation.
currencyMismatchIgnored.other: {count} items in a currency different from the store were ignored in the calculation.

storeBalances.adjustmentNoteHint: Required to record the adjustment (for example: fee not recorded).
storeBalances.checkAdjusted: Check of {store} recorded, with an adjustment of {value}.

form.title: Check balance: {store}
form.intro: Enter the real balance shown on the store website. The app shows what it should be by the calculation and the difference; you choose whether to record an adjustment.
form.amountRequired: Enter the balance (use 0 if it is empty).
form.invalidMoney: Enter a value with at most 2 decimal places (for example 120.50).
form.invalidDate: Enter a valid date and time.

history.title: Balance history: {store}
history.empty: No balance record for this store.
history.deleteMessage: Delete this record? If it has an adjustment, the adjustment stops counting too.
history.note: Deleting a check removes its adjustment from the balance. To fix a check, delete the most recent one and record it again.

storeBalances.startHint: Don't want to enter your old history? Record a deposit with the store's current balance. Real profit will be measured from that date on.
